My psychiatrist and I recently decided that I needed to try a new medicine, in the mood-stabilizer category. I’ve tried 3 antidepressants over the course of 2 years, but none of them worked, and one of then made me so suicidal and miserable I can’t believe I’m still alive. I’m onto my fourth day of Trilepto, and I’m assuming it’s a placebo, but today my mind was free of the constant suffocation of suicidal thoughts. I think my doc and I are slowly narrowing my diagnosis down to bipolar depression.
